novelty.one_liner: Frontier terms absent from OEIS (both entries revised Jun-Aug 2026) and from the cited literature; not a stated-open gap with a waiting table, so not a 5.

usefulness.one_liner: OEIS table-keepers can adopt the values and, more usefully, the completeness method (deficit-multiset M* + window bound); niche sequences limit impact.

provability.one_liner: Complete written minimality proofs: shrinkage lemma, exact deficit characterization of minimal preimages, finite exhaustive window scans; no heuristic component.

reproducibility.one_liner: One-command deterministic rerun (<2 min), SPEC.md sufficient for reimplementation, independent second-algorithm checker with 8/8 tamper rejections; still awaiting cross-session reproduction.

improvement.one_liner: New exact record values extending two published/OEIS sequences by one frontier term each (a(14) has ~7.14e196 digits), plus first-ever minimality proof for a(13).

notes: Scores mirror C-S4-01 (the stronger artifact); C-S4-02 totals 960 due to provability 4 (consumes published A001273 formulas as cited input for the dominance bound).
